title: 1941 FBI vetting of Silas Newton
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 1941 FBI vetting of Silas Newton, about July 1, 1941 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: A document from July 1st, 1941 mentions, he appears to be a good American citizen, has no accent in his speech,

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that FBI files, the records of the US federal police, include a check on a man named Silas Newton. He quotes a document dated July 1st, 1941, which says Newton 'appears to be a good American citizen' and 'has no accent in his speech'. Newton is a central figure in It Came to Earth at Aztec, the work of researchers Scott and Suzanne Ramsay on a claimed saucer crash, so the file bears on how far his word can be trusted.
